source.text:
Schedule 9 Firearms Using Shot Only Areas (Section 10 (1) (a))
1 Those portions of the Province of British Columbia being all areas within 150 m of the travelled portion of the following highways: (1)Highway 1 from the eastern boundary of the corporation of the township of Chilliwack to the northern boundary of M.U. 2-18; (2)Highway 7 from the easterly boundary of Mission to its junction with Highway 1. (3)Repealed. [B.C. Reg. 46/89, s. 10.] [am. B.C. Regs. 46/89, s. 10; 459/90, s. 4.]
